Container.Name: cbz-tagger
Container.Overview: CBZ Tagger tags comic book files in CBZ format so they are compatible with the ComicInfo.xml (ComicRack) metadata standard, using public metadata sources. It embeds cover images and normalises the archive structure for readers such as Komga. Files placed in the /scan directory are imported, tagged and moved into /storage on a recurring timer. A web UI on port 8080 is used to browse tracked series, add new ones, and manage configuration. Set PUID and PGID to the user that owns your share directories, otherwise the files CBZ Tagger writes may not be readable by your other containers.

Config.Name: WebUI
Config.Description: Port for the CBZ Tagger web interface.

Config.Name: Config
Config.Description: Persistent storage for the series database, settings and logs.

Config.Name: Scan
Config.Description: Directory watched for new CBZ files to import. Files are moved out into /storage once processed.

Config.Name: Storage
Config.Description: Directory where tagged files are written. Point your comic reader at this.

Config.Name: Timer Delay
Config.Description: Seconds to wait between scans. Several hours or more is recommended; 43200 is 12 hours.

Config.Name: PUID
Config.Description: User ID applied to files CBZ Tagger writes. 99 is the Unraid 'nobody' user.

Config.Name: PGID
Config.Description: Group ID applied to files CBZ Tagger writes. 100 is the Unraid 'users' group.

Config.Name: UMASK
Config.Description: File mode creation mask for everything written to /storage. 002 gives directories 775 and files 664, so other containers running in the same group can manage the library. Use 022 (755/644) if you want the library group-readable but not group-writable.

Config.Name: Log Level
Config.Description: Logging verbosity. One of DEBUG, INFO, WARNING, ERROR.

Config.Name: Proxy URL
Config.Description: Optional. Routes all outbound metadata requests through this HTTP proxy. The proxy must be reachable whenever this is set.

Config.Name: Timezone
Config.Description: Timezone used for log timestamps and scheduling.

Config.Name: Delay Per Request
Config.Description: Seconds to wait between outbound metadata requests. Raise this if you are being rate limited by the metadata source; lowering it risks getting blocked.
